name: openmontage-autoresearch-overnight-loop
goal: Run up to 50 consecutive OpenMontage autoresearch optimization cycles using the run_montage_experiment skill. Each cycle must mutate only pipeline_mutator.py, test exactly one hypothesis, run python3 prepare.py --evaluate-latest, read logs/latest_experiment.json, commit only SDS improvements, and roll back every regression or crash. Target a reduction of the baseline Structural Dissimilarity Score by at least 20%. Stop early if the budget, runtime, or safety guardrails are reached. Report the final delta score and an executive summary of committed code changes when completed.

activation_note: Declarative project-local cron spec only. The Hermes CLI currently lacks --model/--provider flags for cron create, but the cron backend supports per-job model/provider fields. Register with hermes cron create, then patch ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json so this job has provider=openai-codex and model=gpt-5.5.
